hypotheses.text: Likely root cause: Interface GigabitEthernet0/2 on R1 went down 12 times in 3m 21s. Accounts for 1 of 1 findings; confidence medium.

impact.text: Whatever is connected through this interface was interrupted every time it went down.

fix_steps.text: Look at the error counters of GigabitEthernet0/2 on R1: rising CRC or input errors point at the cable or the optic.
Check that speed and duplex match at both ends.
Reseat or replace the cable and the optic, one at a time, and watch whether the flapping stops.
Shut the interface if the flapping is disturbing the rest of the network and the link can be spared.

verification_commands.purpose: The interface is up, and the CRC, input error and interface reset counters are not rising.
No new up and down messages for this interface.

unknowns: Why the interface went down. The logs show that it did, not whether a cable, an optic or the device at the other end was at fault.
